scope: Frozen-roster HP, single-boundary Stack, connected eclosion, third-grid Core salvos, original pressure/high-pitched audio and disposable Victory rig

calibration.policy: Frozen accepted roster, no survivor rescale; forgiving development calibration; four-player extrapolation unmeasured. Different prior builds/phase structures prevent attributing the DPS ratio solely to player count.

preceding_three_player_pulls.recovery_observation: One recipient was Downed again while the 60-second revive lockout was still active, then exceeded the 30-second Down timeout.

preceding_three_player_pulls.terminal_observation: Last standing participant took a 120-HP lattice hit at 81 HP; one ally was already eliminated and one Downed. One failed Stack excluded a surviving center at 115.9px from the 112px anchor.

log_limits: Authority net HP loss, not raw weapon/per-player DPS. Rounded open seconds can differ from exact tick-based rates. All four revives committed in their request ticks; no Spread overlap hits in these pulls. No Convergence battle exception observed; 21 other-Mod startup warnings and a before-listen socket error have no established relation to Raid HP/sync. Server attendance does not prove peer marker alignment. No private names, IDs or local paths are retained here.

checks.domain: passed: 81 deterministic cases; one initial elbow-speed continuity failure corrected by improving the folded wrist trajectory and rerunning the affected domain command
checks.compiled_codec: passed: v12, 84 round trips over 2/3/4-player snapshots and 24 malformed/truncated cases, including count-before-allocation, early salvos, nonfinite/nonunit direction, roster bound, scaled HP and exact shared-buffer consumption
checks.actual_build_package: passed: actual ModSources compile/package, zero warnings/errors; final draw-only compact-rig adjustment rebuilt, no domain/protocol change afterward
checks.deployment: passed: normal and four existing local test profiles match; old package backed up externally; no Mod-list/world/player changes, no GUI/server launch
checks.audio: passed: five original finite PCM16 48kHz mono exports, sample peaks <=0.92; external PCM24 individual/stem/composite/reel auditions. First-0.33s RMS GridFire 0.538, composite 0.572 versus old grid 0.483. This is not human listening or integrated-loudness acceptance.
checks.static_wrapper: passed once after the final owning-document batch: catalog regenerated/checked (53 indexed documents), repository policy (280 files), YAML (10 files). Passing domain/build/codec commands were not repeated by the wrapper.
checks.multiplayer_runtime: not_run: user-owned normal Host & Play with friend(s), two/three-player HP bars, whole Stack circle, protected half-HP transition, grid-three locked salvos/shared hit cap and cleanup
checks.presentation_runtime: not_run: eclosion/ending visual quality, camera/zoom/mask and mix approval; no rendering-quality claim from compile/math
checks.four_player_calibration: not_run: extrapolated development HP, no four-player evidence
checks.dedicated_server_start: not_run: no persistent session launched in this pass
